scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: First two solved local body/contact levels and fixed-contact comparison

common_fields.scope: Compare solved Panda spatial refinements at fixed material probes and physical times.
common_fields.limitations: Fixed polyhedral geometry and physical held points. Configurations, explicit pairwise varying discretizations and fixed-contact-boundary markers define each comparison; body refinement changes contact triangles unless that boundary is frozen. A collision-only sweep keeps the volume fixed. Fixed material-coordinate interior probes carry seed-volume diagnostic weights, not an exact continuum norm. Tensors use each solution's proper finite body frame; contact wrenches use the shared fixed reference origin. Complete nonlinear global peak lower/upper bounds are retained separately. Two spatial levels or an equal-constructor control do not establish a physical tail. Contact quadrature/regularization/CAD geometry/full-arm support matching and feedback/model/accuracy-cost remain separate required studies.

tractions.scope: Audit collision-surface traction quadrature and islands without nodal-load smoothing.
tractions.limitations: Densities divide unsmoothed collision-vertex force resultants by current barycentric lumped areas. Support area is a quadrature diagnostic, not an independently resolved physical contact boundary. All source normal/friction forces and island wrenches remain visible. Total contact moment can retain finite-gap friction torque; its regularization error is separate from pullback conservation. No contact/stress tail or full-arm matching is inferred from aggregate force stability.

limitations: Two local levels reveal43.03% tensor change and peak growth to562kPa, including fixed-contact control. Two active body nodes/islands retain discrete traction concentration and moving peak location. This does not establish a contact/stress tail or a singularity. Original full goal and every remaining A/B/C, matching, model/feedback and accuracy/cost requirement stay active. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
